name: ninety9-archive
title: NINETY9 — The Monochrome Archive of the 1990s
description: Application #2 built with Kiro + GenUI: 1997 NeXT/Macintosh paper-white monochrome editorial workstation publication archiving 34 historical artifacts across 12 sectors and 1990-1999 decade milestones, featuring toggleable CRT scanlines, 99.4 MHz random packet transmission, and Zod-verified live monochrome remixes.
author: WizFrame

pages.title: NINETY9 · [00] Workstation Home
pages.description: Paper-white editorial masthead, featured artifact split, 12-sector directory, 1990-1999 timeline preview, and 99.4 MHz random packet transmitter.

pages.title: NINETY9 · [01] Searchable Archive Catalog
pages.description: Multi-facet searchable index of all 34 1990s artifacts with 1990-1999 year pills, sector/type selectors, sort order, and interactive dossier reader.

pages.title: NINETY9 · [02] 1990-1999 Decade Timeline
pages.description: Chronological quarterly ledger linking 1990-1999 cultural and hardware breakthroughs directly to indexed dossiers.

pages.title: NINETY9 · [03] Sector Essays & Index
pages.description: Long-form essays, decade shift notes, and monochrome schematic plates across all 12 archival sectors.

pages.title: NINETY9 · [04] Manifesto & Spec Sheet
pages.description: 1997 Paper-White workstation colophon, 5-tone monochrome hex specimen, and CRT scanline calibration.

pages.title: NINETY9 · [05] Workstation Arcade
pages.description: Playable 1-bit monochrome arcade bay featuring Serpent-98, Break-Grid, and Packet Invaders with Web Audio SFX and local high-score persistence.
